fdic_coverage_rules.unit_rule: Per depositor, per separately chartered FDIC-insured bank (unique FDIC Certificate Number), per account ownership category — inclusive of principal plus accrued and posted interest.

official_sources.title: FDIC Deposit Insurance At A Glance

ownership_categories.who_qualifies: Owned by one natural person with no named beneficiaries
ownership_categories.coverage_formula: $250,000 per owner across all single deposit accounts at the same FDIC charter (principal + accrued interest combined)

ownership_categories.who_qualifies: Owned by two or more natural persons with equal withdrawal rights and no named beneficiaries
ownership_categories.coverage_formula: $250,000 per co-owner ($500,000 total for a 2-owner joint savings account at a single bank charter)

ownership_categories.category: Trust Accounts (Informal POD / ITF & Formal Revocable/Irrevocable)
ownership_categories.who_qualifies: Single or joint deposit accounts naming 1 to 5+ unique eligible beneficiaries (Payable on Death / revocable / irrevocable trust)
ownership_categories.coverage_formula: $250,000 per owner per unique eligible beneficiary, up to 5 beneficiaries ($1,250,000 for 1 owner + 5 unique beneficiaries; $2,500,000 for 2 co-owners + 5 unique beneficiaries)

ownership_categories.who_qualifies: Self-directed Traditional IRAs, Roth IRAs, SEP IRAs, and SIMPLE IRAs held as bank deposits
ownership_categories.coverage_formula: $250,000 per owner across all qualifying self-directed retirement deposit accounts at the same bank charter

ownership_categories.category: Program Bank Sweep Network (Multi-Charter Deposit Sweep)
ownership_categories.who_qualifies: Enrolled checking/savings depositors at national banks operating an insured deposit sweep network (e.g., SoFi Insured Deposit Program)
ownership_categories.coverage_formula: Up to $3,000,000 aggregate FDIC coverage across participating network banks ($250,000 per participating bank charter)

brands_sharing_charter: Discover Online Savings (Division of Capital One, N.A.)
same_charter_merger_traps.merger_aggregation_rule: Discover Bank (FDIC Cert #5649) became INACTIVE in the FDIC registry (updated 2025-06-04) following its merger into Capital One, National Association (FDIC Cert #4297). Per Capital One's official disclosure, all Capital One and Discover deposit accounts opened on or after May 18, 2025 are aggregated under a SINGLE $250,000 per-depositor, per-category FDIC insurance limit.

Citizens Access® is an online division of Citizens Bank, N.A., not a separately chartered bank. Deposits held at both Citizens Access and Citizens Bank branches share one combined $250,000 single-owner limit under FDIC Certificate #57957.

Multiple savings, checking, and CD tiers held by the same individual at JPMorgan Chase Bank, N.A. (Cert #628) are combined under one single-owner $250,000 FDIC cap unless separated across distinct legal ownership categories (e.g., Joint or Trust/POD).
